summary: Kimi Antonelli surged to victory at the Circuit of the Americas, leading from pole position to extend his championship lead with a commanding performance that Mercedes boss Toto Wolff called "the race of a champion who isn't the champion yet." The Italian driver's Austin win leaves him needing just two more points to mathematically seal his maiden world title. Antonelli now stands on the brink of his first drivers' championship, with the title within reach at the next race.
